description: This file declares functions and structures related to memory allocation for repository objects such as blobs, trees, commits, and tags in a version control system.

methods.name: alloc_blob_node
methods.description: Allocates memory for a blob node in a repository.

methods.name: alloc_tree_node
methods.description: Allocates memory for a tree node in a repository.

methods.name: init_commit_node
methods.description: Initializes a commit node with a given commit structure.

methods.name: alloc_commit_node
methods.description: Allocates memory for a commit node in a repository.

methods.name: alloc_tag_node
methods.description: Allocates memory for a tag node in a repository.

methods.name: alloc_object_node
methods.description: Allocates memory for a generic object node in a repository.

methods.name: alloc_state_alloc
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new alloc_state structure.

methods.name: alloc_state_free_and_null
methods.description: Frees an alloc_state structure and nullifies its pointer.
